visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static historical black-and-white photograph of Henry Ford and Thomas Edison standing together. Both are elderly men wearing formal dark suits, white shirts, and ties. Ford is on the left, looking slightly away, while Edison is on the right, looking forward. Large bold white text overlays provide their names and titles. (2) A male narrator with a short beard, wearing a black cap and a black button-down shirt, appears in front of a sepia-toned historical backdrop of a city street with horse-drawn carriages. He speaks enthusiastically, gesturing with his right hand. The scene cuts between his close-up and several historical photos of Ford and Edison interacting, shaking hands, and sitting in lawn chairs outdoors. (3) The scene shifts to the man speaking in front of a blue-toned digital graphic of a hospital recovery room. He continues his narration with expressive facial expressions. A small inset image appears to his left, showing a glass test tube sealed with a golden cap. The scene then transitions to the man in a workshop or garage, with various power tools and organized equipment visible on a wall behind him. (4) A transition screen appears in bright yellow with black text. It is followed by a promotional graphic featuring the Ford blue oval logo at the top center. Below the logo, there is an image of a modern white electric car on the left and a vintage black Model T on the right, with a small American flag between them.
